design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (non-workflow, last task) — documentation_release_desk, category bol, M=2. Revision 2 (rebuilt after policy-task audit revision_1).

[Scope] Occupied by task 0: the correction workflow, its three policies and four tools. Claimed here: bol_ext_issuance_originals_count (issue_document_with_originals_c9d717be), bol_ext_telex_full_set_surrender (surrender_full_set_at_origin_68a55055, owner user), bol_ext_telex_release_fee (charge_telex_release_fee_be5da3ed). Revision 2 removed bol_ext_lost_original_void_count and reissue_lost_originals_set_197b224c from the charter and the tools, so every policy and tool is still covered exactly once.

[Why the rebuild — audit G2 / F1-2] The previous middle prerequisite was a lost-original reissue. Base bol_lost_original_reissue gates it on the documentation party's letter of indemnity and bank guarantee in prose only, and bol_service_requests.outcome can only say awaiting_customer_action, so the record could never show that act as done and the task rested on a persona line. The base is frozen, so the task now routes around that clause entirely: no lost original, no reissue request and no reissue write remain in the world or the GT. The middle problem is now issuance of an approved bill whose prepaid freight hold has cleared, and every one of its gates is a structured, recorded fact.

[Why a good test] Surface goal: get the telex release requested on 12 September done. Hidden: a telex release needs the full set surrendered at origin, but the bill (AHL Negotiable Bill of Lading) is still approved and was never issued — the cash_in_advance party's prepaid freight was unpaid until 2026-09-12 (booking_charges a4db3ec2-6365-4c84-8a92-8aee9a96cc99), so bol_issuance's prepaid hold kept it back after the 2026-08-12 departure. The agent must issue the bill (3 originals, fee 75.00), have the shipper's clerk at the Shanghai counter surrender the full set of 3, then book the telex fee, checking the exemption: the booking's active AHL Key Account Contract ranks 4 and the negotiable tier's waiver rank is 5, so the fee is 55.00 (a combined transport bill would have been exempt at 4). The caller's belief that contract customers pay nothing is a trap settled by the record.

[Who surrenders — audit G1 / F1-1] bol_ext_telex_full_set_surrender now follows base: the shipper printed on the document, who alone can hand in the originals, surrenders; the documentation party's surrender is taken only when it is that printed shipper, otherwise the request waits. The tool docstring says the same. In this world Kestrel Bay Logistics Ltd is an NVOCC shipping in its own name: bills_of_lading.9793c975-c98d-435c-8c79-5ae475a1b478.shipper_name = 'Kestrel Bay Logistics Ltd' = customers.b4c6eecf-dbde-499f-92b7-de5b19d9fe38.company_name, so the shipper and the documentation party are the same company and the owner=user surrender (by its clerk) is the shipper's own act. Reading 1 of the audit no longer yields a second terminal state.

[Problem-tree card] Root bol_ext_telex_release_fee. E1 root -> bol_ext_telex_full_set_surrender, value_input, binding effected; false at opening: status approved, originals_outstanding 0, request 5bd876eb-aa6b-4e7b-9fd9-53ee48bf8e9f awaiting. E2 surrender -> bol_ext_issuance_originals_count, value_input, binding in_circulation; policy_source 'A document that has not yet been issued has no originals in circulation, so the full set can be surrendered only after the document has been issued under bol_issuance and its originals put into circulation.'; false at opening: status approved, issued_date empty, no ledger entries. Chain, so the only order is issuance (step 10) -> surrender (12) -> fee (14). Sensitivity run (verify.py 1, revision 2): 'telex_release_fee <- telex_full_set_surrender value_input with 55.0 without 0.0 hash differs True'; 'telex_full_set_surrender <- issuance_originals_count value_input with 3 without 0 hash differs True'.

[Base-invariant card] step 10 bol_issued (bol_issuance): shipped_on_board — booking status departed; prepaid_settled — freight prepaid, booking charges_due 0.00 after payment KBL-FRT-24418 of 2026-09-12, party cash_in_advance (no credit exemption needed). step 12 bol_originals_surrender_completed (bol_telex_release): documentation_party_only — the caller's company holds the record and is the printed shipper. step 14 bol_release_fee_charged: documentation_party_only; full_set_surrendered and telex_fee_on_surrendered established by step 12; release_request_charged_once — the surrender entry of step 12 carries request 5bd876eb-aa6b-4e7b-9fd9-53ee48bf8e9f and no fee row exists; bol_cargo_release.loi_after_discharge, which base attaches to every release fee row (audit O11): discharge 2026-09-09 + 3 = 2026-09-12 inclusive, frozen 2026-09-14, so it holds under both readings.

[Business-object card] Document 9793c975-c98d-435c-8c79-5ae475a1b478 (AHLU2608261734), booking dae59fbe-d1b3-4c1b-92ef-b291e173f105 (AHLU26SHA274613, contract 767c599a-30ea-4fbb-b1a3-dffd0305d290), telex request 5bd876eb-aa6b-4e7b-9fd9-53ee48bf8e9f, dnd record d3c84534-eb56-4601-a1a8-d9109ef84173 (AHLU2493178, gate evidence only), booking charges 580a37d4-74f4-4b8c-82f7-5ab027d5b198 (freight 2850.00) and a4db3ec2-6365-4c84-8a92-8aee9a96cc99 (payment 2850.00).

[Policies — two-way] bol_ext_issuance_originals_count: approved <- 'status is approved at the moment of issue'; per_set <- tier originals_issued_count; shipped <- booking status clause; the prepaid hold decides issuability, not the number; the booking read is the documentation party's own (O1); zero is not a permission (O5). bol_ext_telex_full_set_surrender: whole-history balance, the issuance sentence, the shipper sentence (G1). bol_ext_telex_release_fee: effected, contract via the booking's contract_id (declared overwrite of the base 'holds an active service contract' clause), rank ladder from params, exempt, rounding wording (O2), holder scoping (O1).

[Persona] Priscilla Tam, courteous and anxious NVOCC supervisor; volunteers only the telex release goal and that Kestrel is the printed shipper on its bills; phone +85232748105 and code AHL-HK-258931 on request; freight paid 12 September (KBL-FRT-24418) only if asked; no originals ever received and her clerk Mr Leung at the Shanghai counter only if asked about originals; has the clerk hand in exactly what the agent says; accepts the issuance fee; queries the telex fee against her contract and accepts the answer; pays nothing today; closes when the telex release is done.

[Standard solution] find_customers -> verify(phone, code) -> find_bills_of_lading -> find_bookings -> find_booking_charges -> find_bol_ledger -> find_bol_service_requests -> find_service_contracts -> find_dnd_free_time -> issue_document_with_originals (3, 75.00) -> call(user) surrender_full_set_at_origin (request, set 1, 3) -> charge_telex_release_fee 55.00. Terminal: surrendered, set 1, outstanding 0, charges_due 130.00, request completed.

[Verification run, revision 2] 'bol_ext_issuance_originals_count 10 3 expected 3'; 'bol_ext_telex_full_set_surrender 12 3 expected 3'; 'bol_ext_telex_release_fee 14 55.0 expected 55.0'. Gates: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK (closure 8 = initial 8), SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (25 factors, 18 branches), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.

[Traps] waiving the telex fee for the Key Account contract (rank 4 < 5); booking the telex fee on an unissued or unsurrendered bill (0 by the rule); surrendering before issuance (count 0); forgetting the issuance fee is due at issue.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] telex needs full set surrendered by the shipper -> bill approved, never issued, freight now paid -> issue (3 originals, 75.00) -> clerk surrenders 3 -> fee 55.00. Matches gold.

[Revisions] r1: bool() removed from the telex fee compute. r2 (audit): G2/F1-2 — lost-original reissue removed; new middle problem bol_ext_issuance_originals_count with tool issue_document_with_originals_c9d717be; world rebuilt (bill approved, prepaid hold cleared, booking charges seeded, no ledger rows); G1/F1-1 — surrender policy and tool follow the base shipper rule, and the documentation party is the printed shipper; the surrender tool now records the telex request it answers. O1, O2, O4 (moot, the latest-request anchor went with the removed policy), O5 and O11 are handled as listed above.

[Revision 3 (audit revision_2)] O17: the persona no longer says the charges 'go on the monthly statement', which read as credit terms against the cash_in_advance profile; she now says she pays nothing during this call and that her accounts team pays the line's documentation invoices by bank transfer separately, which is consistent with cash_in_advance and writes nothing (no bol policy gates the issuance fee, the telex fee or the telex release on paying documentation fees). O15: bol_ext_telex_full_set_surrender now states how the shipper is identified: the documentation party counts as the printed shipper only when its registered company_name matches the document's shipper_name exactly, character for character; here 'Kestrel Bay Logistics Ltd' on both, so the surrender is the shipper's own act. O14: issue_document_with_originals_c9d717be now writes the originals-issued entry only when the given count is above zero, matching its docstring and base's waybill exception; here the count is 3, so the writes are unchanged. The two edge_load_bearing sentences were rewritten to the exact replayed terminals (skip surrender -> issued, outstanding 3; skip issuance -> surrendered, outstanding -3, charges_due 55.00 instead of 130.00). Values and figures re-run in revision 3 (scratch replay): issuance 3, surrender 3, telex fee 55.0; skip surrender -> fee 0.0; skip issuance -> surrender 0; both hashes differ. Per-task gates re-run: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
user_scenario: You are Priscilla Tam, documentation supervisor at Kestrel Bay Logistics Ltd, a Hong Kong NVOCC that ships its consolidated cargo in its own name, so your company is the shipper printed on its Aurelia Hanse Line bills. You are courteous, a little anxious and apologetic, and you tend to explain the background at length. The container on negotiable bill of lading AHLU2608261734 has been discharged in Hamburg and your agent there cannot take it; on 12 September your team asked the line for a telex release on that bill, and you are calling today to get that telex release done so the cargo can be collected. You are content for the agent to carry out whatever the line itself has to record, and you will do any part that has to be done by your company when the agent tells you what it is. You start by explaining that you are chasing the telex release on bill AHLU2608261734. If the agent asks how to find your account you give your phone number, +85232748105, and when a second detail is needed you give your customer code, AHL-HK-258931; you do not have the tax registration or account-opening date to hand. The booking number, if the agent asks, is AHLU26SHA274613. You do not know what the line has to do internally and you never suggest a step. Only if the agent asks about the ocean freight do you say it was paid on 12 September under reference KBL-FRT-24418. Only if the agent asks about the original bills do you say that your company has never received any originals for this bill, and that your clerk, Mr Leung, is at the line's Shanghai documentation counter this morning with paperwork for other shipments. If the agent tells you that the bill has to be issued first and that its originals then have to be handed straight back, you ask the agent to go ahead, and when the agent gives you the step you have Mr Leung hand in exactly the originals the agent says and confirm it is done. If the agent mentions an issuance fee you accept it. If the agent mentions a telex release fee, you say you thought contract customers did not pay for telex releases and ask the agent to check it against your contract; whatever the agent then tells you, you accept it and do not argue. You are not paying anything during this call; your accounts team pays the line's documentation invoices by bank transfer separately, and you have no payment reference to give. When the agent confirms the telex release is done, you thank them warmly and end the call; there is nothing else you need.
